items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe beim Landratsamt Musterbreisgau, Stadtstraße 2, 79104 Musterfreiburg, Widerspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter is headed 11.07.2025 (a Friday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so this counts as the posting date. Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 → delivery (Bekanntgabe) = posting date + 4 calendar days = 15.07.2025 (Tuesday). The Landratsamt is a general (non-tax) authority in BW, so even if this day fell on a weekend/holiday it would not move; here it is a Tuesday. Per § 70 VwGO the one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, delivery day itself not counted) and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 15.08.2025. 15.08.2025 is a Friday and is not a public holiday in Baden-Württemberg (Mariä Himmelfahrt/Assumption Day is not a BW holiday), so the deadline is not shifted (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 57 VwGO i.V.m. § 222 ZPO would only shift it if it fell on a weekend/holiday).
